title: Odd Orbits — A pocket solar system
description: A vivid editorial-style cosmic playground with lime and lavender accents, a procedural 3D solar system, eight selectable planets, floating field notes, tracked close-up views, orbit paths, keyboard camera controls, and a responsive planet strip and time deck.

knownLimitations: Browser and runtime interaction checks were not performed because localhost browser access is unavailable and prohibited for this run.
Planet sizes, orbital distances, motion, positions and surface appearance are deliberately stylized rather than scientifically precise; the interface explicitly labels this.
Planet reference facts are approximate static values, not a live astronomical data source.
WebGL-unavailable and context-loss states retain the planet facts and selection controls, but require reloading to retry the 3D view.
